mapper.select: select id, event_id, event_type, user_id, order_id, product_code, event_published, base_quota, create_time, update_time from benefit_event where order_id = #{orderId} and event_type = #{eventType} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into benefit_event(event_id, event_type, user_id, order_id, product_code, event_published, base_quota, create_time, update_time) values(#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{userId}, #{orderId}, #{productCode}, #{eventPublished}, #{baseQuota}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update benefit_event set event_published = 1, update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and event_published = 0
mapper.select: select id, event_id, event_type, user_id, order_id, product_code, event_published, base_quota, create_time, update_time from benefit_event where event_published = 0 order by case when event_type = 'GROUP_BUY_REVOKED' then 0 else 1 end, id asc limit #{limit}
